summary: Recorded TG-6C lifecycle node template implementation and validation

assertions: Python and Java templates expose deploy_cluster, reset_node, and delete_cluster behavior.
Templates accept local, github-action, and aws target/backend options.
Reset skips when the environment was just provisioned or is already reset.
Delete only destroys when explicit destroy intent is present; skip-destroy keeps the cluster active.
Shared helper code owns target dispatch and command selection.
The test graph proves every generated lifecycle template has both uv and JBang coverage or records an explicit unsupported-runtime reason.
